# The Lemon Index

> Car reliability from public data. The Lemon Index = NHTSA owner complaints in the first 3 years per 100,000 U.S. sales, vs the average car of the same model years (100 = average). It measures complaints, not crash safety.

- [The Most Reliable Cars, According to 1.6 Million Owner Complaints](https://lemonindex.com/studies/most-reliable-cars/): Toyota 4Runner 26, Lexus ES 27, Lexus brand 30, Tesla brand 322 (est.)
- [The Most Reliable Electric Cars](https://lemonindex.com/electric/): 22 EVs by NHTSA complaints per car sold, best Volvo XC90 58, plus fires, yearly cost and driver-assist crash reports
- [Engine code lookup](https://lemonindex.com/check-engine-light/): what any OBD-II trouble code means, how serious it is, and which cars owners report it on most in NHTSA complaints
- [Car symptoms](https://lemonindex.com/symptoms/): what a shake, noise, smell or warning light usually means, how serious it is, and which models and years owners report it on most in NHTSA complaints
- [Free engine illustrations](https://lemonindex.com/images/): free BMW engine illustrations, CC BY 4.0 (AI-generated, credit The Lemon Index)
- [Every car engine](https://lemonindex.com/engines/): every engine with a page (BMW, supercar, performance, Honda Civic), searchable, YouTube owner ranks
- [BMW engines by year](https://lemonindex.com/engines/bmw/): every BMW engine (N54, N55, B58, N63 ...) by model year: US versions and specs (EPA), owner complaints (NHTSA) and a YouTube score
- [Supercar engines by year](https://lemonindex.com/engines/supercars/): 39 supercar engines (Ferrari F154, Lamborghini V10, McLaren M838T, Nissan VR38DETT ...) matched to their cars (EPA), with a YouTube owner score by model year, NHTSA recalls and automaker repair notes
- [Performance car engines by year](https://lemonindex.com/engines/performance/): 48 performance-car engines (Hellcat, Coyote, LS3, LS7, 2UR-GSE, EJ257, S65, S85 ...) matched to their cars (EPA), with a YouTube owner score by model year, NHTSA recalls and automaker repair notes
- [UK MOT pass rates](https://lemonindex.com/uk/): 115 pages on how UK car models do at their MOT against cars the same age (first-time pass rate by year of first registration, top failure reasons, mileage), from DVSA anonymised MOT test data (Open Government Licence v3.0)
- [Car repair costs](https://lemonindex.com/repair-cost/): what owners reported paying for 69 repairs (transmission, engine, water pump, timing chain ...), from repair bills in NHTSA complaints and amounts said in YouTube videos, with sample sizes, per model where 5+ owners reported
- [Method](https://lemonindex.com/method/)
- [Car complaint statistics](https://lemonindex.com/stats/car-complaints/): 929,012 NHTSA owner complaints by model year, brand, system and fuel type, with a ready citation (CC BY 4.0). The 2017 Chevrolet Volt drew the most owner complaints per car sold of any model year from 2015 to 2022: a Lemon Index of 856, about 8.6 times the average car of that year. The brand with the fewest complaints per car sold is Lexus (Lemon Index 30). The most: Tesla (322). 100 is the average car. Electrical is the most common problem area: 18% of complaint mentions, then engine (17%) and transmission & drivetrain (16%). Electric cars drew 213 complaints per 100,000 sold, against 50 for other cars of the same model years (2021–2024): about 4.3 times as many. Without driver-assist complaints, 2.7 times. Only 35% of the complaints filed so far about 2010–2022 model years of the 130 models we rank came in within 3 years of the model year. The other 65% came later.
- [Embed a car reliability chart](https://lemonindex.com/embed/): free iframe charts of owner complaints by model year for every scored model, credit built in (CC BY 4.0)
- [Car recall check](https://lemonindex.com/recalls/): every NHTSA recall campaign (5,066) on the 340 models we track, by make, model and year, with vehicles covered and park-it warnings; check by VIN or pick the car (live from NHTSA)
- [Free VIN check](https://lemonindex.com/vin/): decode a VIN (NHTSA vPIC) and see that model year: its Lemon Index, top problems, complaints and recalls
